	NOT = { has_variable = qpq_war_joined }

qpq_any_pact_possible_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}

			exists = scope:actor.primary_title
			scope:actor.primary_title = { any_elector = { this = scope:recipient } }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				OR = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_courtier_of = scope:actor
				}
				is_adult = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				OR = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_courtier_of = scope:actor
				}
				is_adult = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				OR = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_courtier_of = scope:actor
				}
				is_adult = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				OR = {
					liege ?= scope:actor
					is_courtier_of = scope:actor
				}
				is_adult = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
			scope:recipient = { any_vassal = { is_landed = yes } }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
			scope:recipient = { any_character_artifact = { always = yes } }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				liege ?= scope:actor
				is_landed = yes
			}
			scope:recipient = { any_claim = { always = yes } }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = { NOT = { this = scope:actor } }
			scope:actor = {
				any_secret = { is_known_by = scope:recipient }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
			scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:actor = {
				liege ?= scope:recipient
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:actor = {
				OR = {
					liege ?= scope:recipient
					is_imprisoned_by = scope:recipient
				}
				any_known_secret = {
					NOT = { secret_owner = scope:actor }
					NOT = { secret_owner = scope:recipient }
					NOT = { is_known_by = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			exists = scope:recipient.primary_title
			scope:recipient.primary_title = { any_elector = { this = scope:actor } }
			NOT = { scope:actor = scope:recipient }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_landed = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			exists = scope:actor.liege
			scope:actor.liege = scope:recipient.liege
		}
		AND = {
			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_landed = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			exists = scope:actor.liege
			scope:actor.liege = scope:recipient.liege
			scope:actor = { exists = joined_faction joined_faction = { faction_target = scope:actor.liege } }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_landed = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			exists = scope:actor.liege
			scope:actor.liege = scope:recipient.liege
		}
		AND = {
			exists = scope:actor.liege
			scope:recipient = {
				is_adult = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				NOT = { this = scope:actor.liege }
				OR = {
					is_courtier_of = scope:actor.liege
					is_courtier_of = scope:actor
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_independent_ruler = yes
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_independent_ruler = yes
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes } scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes } scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_independent_ruler = yes
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

			scope:recipient = {
				exists = liege
				is_independent_ruler = no
			}
			scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient.liege }
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_landed = yes
				is_independent_ruler = no
				exists = liege
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				is_adult = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				any_claim = { tier >= tier_duchy NOT = { holder ?= scope:actor } }
			}
			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_independent_ruler = yes
				is_landed = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

			scope:recipient = {
				is_councillor = yes
				exists = liege
				is_councillor_of = scope:recipient.liege
			}
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_landed = yes
				is_independent_ruler = no
				exists = liege
			}
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_landed = yes
				is_independent_ruler = no
				exists = liege
			}
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

			exists = scope:actor.house
			scope:recipient = {
				is_landed = yes
				OR = {
					any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
					any_close_family_member = {
						OR = {
							any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
							betrothed.house ?= scope:actor.house
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }
			scope:recipient = {
				any_held_title = { is_holy_order = yes }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
			scope:recipient.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

			scope:recipient.faith = {
				OR = {
					qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes
					has_doctrine = doctrine_divorce_approval
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
			scope:recipient.faith = { suitable_faith_for_any_ghw_trigger = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
			scope:recipient.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
			scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_spiritual_head }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
			scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } scope:recipient.faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
			scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county } scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_temporal_head }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

			scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				exists = clerical_elector_title
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				is_clergy = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith
			scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors }
			has_dlc_feature = by_god_alone
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith
			scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_sunni_doctrine }
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_landed = yes
				is_independent_ruler = no
				exists = liege
			}

			scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
			scope:recipient.religion = religion:islam_religion
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				religion = religion:islam_religion
				OR = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					AND = {
						is_clergy = yes
						learning >= 15
					}
				}
			}
			scope:actor.religion = religion:islam_religion
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				faith = scope:actor.faith
				OR = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					AND = { is_clergy = yes learning >= 12 }
				}
			}
			scope:actor.faith = { has_doctrine = muhammad_succession_shia_doctrine }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

			scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
			scope:actor = {
				is_independent_ruler = no
				top_liege = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_empire }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith

			scope:recipient.faith = faith:orthodox
			scope:actor = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				faith = scope:actor.faith
				OR = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					this = scope:actor.realm_priest
				}
			}
			scope:actor.religion = { is_in_family = rf_pagan }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				faith = scope:actor.faith
				OR = {
					qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes
					this = scope:actor.realm_priest
				}
			}
			scope:actor.religion = { is_in_family = rf_eastern }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = {
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				faith = scope:actor.faith
				OR = {
					is_clergy = yes
					government_has_flag = government_is_theocracy
				}
			}
			NOT = { exists = scope:actor.faith.religious_head }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:recipient = { is_tributary_of = scope:actor }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:actor = { is_tributary_of = scope:recipient }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:actor = { is_tributary_of = scope:recipient }
		}
		AND = {
			scope:actor = {
				is_landed = yes
				is_independent_ruler = yes
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				is_landed = yes
				is_independent_ruler = yes
				is_tributary = no
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
			scope:recipient = {
				is_tributary = yes
				exists = suzerain
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
				NOT = { suzerain = scope:actor }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = { scope:actor = scope:recipient }
		}
	}
}

qpq_k_chartered_conquest_ai_valid_trigger = {
	is_landed = yes
	any_vassal = { is_landed = yes is_ai = yes }
}
qpq_k_sanctioned_conquest_ai_valid_trigger = {
	is_landed = yes
	any_vassal = { is_landed = yes is_ai = yes }
}
qpq_k_marcher_charge_ai_valid_trigger = {
	is_landed = yes any_vassal = { is_landed = yes is_ai = yes }
}
qpq_k_licensed_feud_ai_valid_trigger = {
	is_landed = yes any_vassal = { count >= 2 is_landed = yes }
}
qpq_k_dossier_ai_valid_trigger = {
	is_landed = yes any_vassal = { count >= 2 }
}
qpq_k_quiet_removal_ai_valid_trigger = {
	is_landed = yes
	any_relation = { type = rival }
	OR = { has_trait = deceitful has_trait = callous has_trait = sadistic has_trait = vengeful has_trait = schemer }
}
qpq_k_blessing_for_a_feud_ai_valid_trigger = {
	is_landed = yes
	exists = liege
	any_relation = { type = rival liege ?= root.liege is_landed = yes }
}
qpq_k_clemency_bargain_ai_valid_trigger = {
	exists = liege
	any_known_secret = { NOT = { secret_owner = root } NOT = { is_known_by = root.liege } }
	liege = { has_imprisonment_reason = root }
}
qpq_k_electoral_capitulation_ai_valid_trigger = {
	exists = liege
	exists = liege.primary_title
	liege.primary_title = { any_elector = { this = root } }
	OR = { has_trait = greedy has_trait = ambitious }
}
qpq_k_mutual_defense_league_ai_valid_trigger = {
	exists = liege
	opinion = { target = root.liege value <= -10 }
	liege = { any_vassal = { count >= 2 } }
}
qpq_k_title_swap_ai_valid_trigger = {
	exists = liege is_landed = yes
}
qpq_k_coup_pact_ai_valid_trigger = {
	exists = liege
	opinion = { target = root.liege value <= -50 }
	OR = { has_trait = ambitious has_trait = deceitful has_trait = callous }
}
qpq_k_proxy_war_ai_valid_trigger = {
	is_independent_ruler = yes any_relation = { type = rival is_landed = yes }
}
qpq_k_secret_alliance_ai_valid_trigger = {
	is_landed = yes is_at_war = no
}
qpq_k_bought_truce_ai_valid_trigger = {
	is_at_war = yes gold >= 50
}
qpq_k_faithless_ally_ai_valid_trigger = {
	is_at_war = yes
}
qpq_k_turncoat_ai_valid_trigger = {
	is_at_war = yes
}
qpq_k_seed_the_separatists_ai_valid_trigger = {
	is_independent_ruler = yes any_relation = { type = rival is_independent_ruler = yes }
}
qpq_k_bought_claim_ai_valid_trigger = {
	exists = faith.religious_head
	NOT = { faith.religious_head = root }
	faith.religious_head = { is_ai = yes }
	faith = { has_doctrine = doctrine_spiritual_head }
	any_relation = { type = rival is_landed = yes }
}
qpq_k_absolution_by_concession_ai_valid_trigger = {
	has_trait = excommunicated exists = faith.religious_head faith.religious_head = { is_ai = yes } faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes }
}
